notes: Nexxt Solutions (nexxtsolutions.com, Latin-American connectivity/IoT brand) sells smart-home Wi-Fi cameras as part of a cloud/app ecosystem (Nexxt Home app, Tuya-based). The official site (checked 2026-09-10) organizes products under Connectivity and Infrastructure and, while it has a Support / Downloads section, exposes no camera user manual, datasheet, or API guide specifying a fixed RTSP URL path or port; the camera products page (/products/cameras/) returns 404. The scan-DB Hikvision-OEM hypothesis (/Streaming/channels/101) could NOT be confirmed against any Nexxt-authored document, and Nexxt's published cameras are app/cloud-managed consumer devices rather than a documented Hikvision rebrand. Per the no-guessing rule and the OEM-only-if-confirmed rule, no template is published. To integrate, use ONVIF discovery or the vendor app.
